pick.name: brand/ folder in a GitHub repo (+ any cloud drive or Git LFS for large source files)
pick.what: SVG logos, tokens (CSS/JSON), fonts, guidelines PDF versioned in Git; videos/raw files in Drive
pick.why: Code consumes tokens and assets directly, Claude Code keeps everything in sync, and there is no extra vendor; keep heavy source files (video, PSD) in Git LFS or whichever cloud drive the team uses.
pick.free_limits: Free; GitHub warns at files over 50 MB and blocks over 100 MB, so use Git LFS or a cloud drive for large files

alts.name: Canva Brand Kit
alts.why: Useful if non-technical helpers make graphics in Canva; free = 1 limited kit.

alts.name: Brandfetch
alts.why: Claim your profile so partners/press pull correct logos.

decision: A versioned brand folder is the source of truth that both code and Claude read. Add Canva Brand Kit only when other people make graphics.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
